# DumbbellChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDumbbellChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDumbbellChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDumbbellChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasDumbbellChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Two paired values per category (before / after)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasDumbbellChart> CreateDumbbellChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasDumbbellChart> CreateDumbbellChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<DumbbellDataSource> data, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasDumbbellChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onDotClick` | `std::function<void(size_t rowIndex, int dotIndex)> onDotClick` | rowIndex is the index into the data source, dotIndex is 0 for value1 and 1 for value2 |
| `onRowClick` | `std::function<void(size_t rowIndex)> onRowClick` | _Row click_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `DumbbellDataPoint`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `categoryLabel` | `std::string categoryLabel` | Row label, e.g. "Instagram 16-20" |
| `value1` | `double value1` | First value, e.g. men 68 |
| `value2` | `double value2` | Second value, e.g. women 83 |
| `label1` | `std::string label1` | Name of the first group |
| `label2` | `std::string label2` | Name of the second group |
| `color1` | `Color color1` | Dot colour for value1 (transparent = use chart default) |
| `color2` | `Color color2` | Dot colour for value2 (transparent = use chart default) |
| `lineColor` | `Color lineColor` | Connector colour (transparent = use chart default) |
| `tooltipText` | `std::string tooltipText` | Optional custom tooltip replacing the generated one. Tooltips are rendered as Pango markup: the generated text escapes &, &lt; and &gt; for you, but text supplied here is passed through verbatim so it can carry markup. |

Methods: `GetRange`, `GetDelta`, `GetMinValue`, `GetMaxValue`

### enum `DumbbellValueLabelPlacement`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Auto` | Inside the dots when they are big enough, otherwise outside |
| `Inside` | Always centred on the dots |
| `Outside` | Always beyond the outer edge of each dot |
